scenes.text_anchor: Sharp nose, thin eyebrows, slightly droopy cheeks

scenes.setting: A cramped Cherwood apartment: hiding from both Qilangos and the authorities, musing on fortuitous encounters and their dangers
scenes.text_anchor: Backlund, Cherwood Backlund. In a particular cramped apartment.

scenes.setting: Duke Negan's grand ball: 'Baron Gramir' greets Audrey — but the wrong cologne note and new confidence scream Qilangos to a full Spectator
scenes.text_anchor: Duke Negan was in his mansion located in Backlund, Empress Borough

scenes.setting: A quiet balcony corner: Audrey lays out the discrepancies for her father, whose face turns grave before he sends her to her mother
scenes.text_anchor: The more Audrey thought about it, the more possible it seemed.

scenes.setting: Duke Negan's small prayer room: under the Lord of Storms' symbol, Audrey kneels and recites The Fool's honorific name
scenes.text_anchor: She surveyed the area and changed the direction in which she was heading in.

scenes.setting: Daffodil Street: planning a family outing to 'The Return of the Count' — until a buzz in Klein's ears announces a prayer
scenes.text_anchor: Tingen City, Daffodil Street.

scenes.setting: Above the gray fog (visions only: Justice praying in a dark corner): Qilangos is at Duke Negan's ball as Baron Gramir — The Fool weighs his options
scenes.text_anchor: Klein went to the second floor and locked the door to his room.

scenes.setting: Leaving the prayer room: the fog rises around Audrey and Mr. Fool's deep voice answers 'I'm aware' — her unease melts away
scenes.text_anchor: In a small prayer room in Duke Negan's mansion.

scenes.setting: The palace above the fog: Justice's prayer re-cut into a censored 'film' and launched at The Hanged Man's star
scenes.text_anchor: In the magnificent palace in the world of fog.

scenes.setting: Holy Wind Cathedral: the fog descends even here — Alger sees the prayer replay and heads for Archbishop Ace Snake
scenes.text_anchor: Backlund, Cherwood Backlund. At the Holy Wind Cathedral.

scenes.setting: Back in the bedroom: a tip-off letter to Azik goes out with the bone messenger; Klein reasons the ball's noble guards should hold
scenes.text_anchor: After forwarding Miss Justice's description to The Hanged Man

scenes.setting: The assassination at the ball: the chandelier falls, but Duke Negan is himself a fearsome Beyonder — 'Imprison! Flog! Death!' — Qilangos burns abilities, sows panic, and blasts out a window
scenes.text_anchor: In Duke Negan's mansion, in the dancing hall.

scenes.setting: A gale delivers Archbishop Ace Snake and his Mandated Punishers — with Alger among them, arriving to shattered windows and an escaped admiral
scenes.text_anchor: After a while, there was gale blowing towards Duke Negan's mansion.

scenes.setting: Past the man-made lake: the world saturates like pastel paint — Azik's ambush; one four-meter bone skeleton is purified by borrowed Priest of Light power, then a hundred more appear
scenes.text_anchor: Qilangos lost his pursuers with the help of the wind

scenes.setting: The pursuit fans out: Ace Snake takes to the air on a typhoon while the nobles watch from balconies and Alger sprints for the garden
scenes.text_anchor: Spread out and pursue him. Try to corner him

scenes.setting: The pond bank: Qilangos rots to bones in twenty seconds before Alger's eyes — who concludes it was The Fool's adorer, and chooses loyalty
scenes.text_anchor: Suddenly, he heard a voice which was carried to him by the wind

scenes.setting: The mansion balcony: Count Hall confirms Qilangos is dead — killer and motive unknown; Audrey privately credits the Tarot Club
scenes.text_anchor: In Duke Negan's mansion, Audrey Hall, who was discussing the assassination

scenes.setting: The balcony continues: Audrey deduces the adorer did it, dodges fame to protect 'Justice', and quietly banks a forty-thousand-pound reward
scenes.text_anchor: Audrey analyzed many things at once as her mind whirled.

scenes.setting: Duke Negan's secret study: the Duke, the Prime Minister and the Cardinal agree — an unknown Demigod walks Backlund, and every church must be alerted
scenes.text_anchor: In Duke Negan's mansion, in a secret study room.

scenes.setting: A North Borough hotel: Azik studies the skin-thin Creeping Hunger in agony — 'I seem to have cooperated with them before'
scenes.text_anchor: In a hotel in the North Borough of Backlund.

scenes.setting: Morning carriage to Zouteland Street: the paperboy's cry — Qilangos dead — and the boss behind the scenes learns his outcome from a penny paper
scenes.text_anchor: Klein didn't sleep well the entire night

scenes.setting: The public carriage buzzes over the news: bounty talk stings — ten thousand pounds Klein can never claim; the Qilangos affair closes
scenes.text_anchor: The article covering what happened to Qilangos wasn't long

scenes.setting: Cherwood street: the paperboy's cry stuns the pair mid-walk — Qilangos dead before step one of the plan; they resolve to wait for Audrey to reach out
scenes.text_anchor: Backlund, Cherwood Borough.

scenes.setting: Blackthorn reception: a veiled widow Maynard arrives with a commission — track Madam Sharon and find evidence of her crimes
scenes.text_anchor: After a busy morning, Klein returned to the Blackthorn Security Company.

scenes.setting: The commission signed: two weeks tailing Madam Sharon for up to 250 pounds — and Dunn hands the whole job to Klein as tailing practice
scenes.text_anchor: Madam Sharon? Dunn obviously knew of Baron Khoy's widow

scenes.setting: Preparation days: a subcontracted triad watches Sharon's routine; Azik's one-line letter confirms he killed Qilangos and took the Creeping Hunger
scenes.text_anchor: Based on Leonard's guidance, Klein wasn't in a hurry

scenes.setting: Osna Street by night: over the wall, up the pipe, tarot-card lockpicking into Madam Sharon's aphrodisiac-scented bedroom
scenes.text_anchor: Gas street lamps illuminated the straight Osna Street at night

scenes.setting: Madam Sharon's opulent bedroom: a gloved search past the narcissistic self-portrait to an explosives-proof safe — lockpicking not required for a Seer
scenes.text_anchor: A few seconds later, Klein activated his Spirit Vision

scenes.setting: A sandalwood candle for an altar: the self-summoning ritual performed right in Sharon's bedroom
scenes.text_anchor: The process was simple since he was praying to himself.

scenes.setting: Above the gray fog: interference stripped away, the pendulum flips both answers — Maynard's death WAS supernatural, and Madam Sharon IS a Beyonder
scenes.text_anchor: He saw the Door of Summoning appear behind the seat of honor

scenes.setting: Spirit-body through the safe: gold, sealed papers, a photo of a young man too much like Sharon herself — and a hidden compartment holding the snake-haired goddess statue
scenes.text_anchor: After a moment of chaos and dizziness, he saw Madam Sharon's bedroom and himself.

scenes.setting: An ominous premonition — Sharon's carriage returns; Klein ends the summon, retraces his route, and flees to a night carriage without resetting the balcony bolt
scenes.text_anchor: Klein rushed out of the heavy safe in retreat.

scenes.setting: Sharon's bedroom: her deer-pure eyes catch the fallen hair-thin tripwires — her gaze locks onto the safe
scenes.text_anchor: Madam Sharon, who looked beautiful in her black dress

scenes.setting: Blackthorn at night: the Primordial Demoness statue confirmed — immediate action ordered with Sealed Artifact 3-0217, the Spirit Medium's Mirror, in Kenley's hands
scenes.text_anchor: 36 Zouteland Street, the Blackthorn Security Company.

scenes.setting: The tense carriage ride and arrival at Osna Street: Klein's pendulum reads medium danger inside the silent house
scenes.text_anchor: On their way there, Kenley looked at the Sealed Artifact 3-0217 in his hands.

scenes.setting: Outside Sharon's house: the plan — Dunn will lull her into sleep from a hundred meters while Klein and Kenley move in
scenes.text_anchor: There's danger in there. Not very high, but it isn't very low either

scenes.setting: The opulent bedroom: Sharon admires herself in the full-length mirror beside the goddess statue as her eyelids droop
scenes.text_anchor: In the opulent bedroom.

scenes.setting: Dunn's dream doubles as the go-signal; Klein and Kenley steel themselves for the capture
scenes.text_anchor: Seconds turned into minutes when Klein suddenly recalled something.

scenes.setting: The bedroom is a trap: the 'sleeping' Sharon is a mirror-decoy — Kenley catches his own reflection in 3-0217 as the real Sharon appears; Klein hurls a Slumber Charm
scenes.text_anchor: Let's go. As a Sequence 8, Klein took on the role of the leader

scenes.setting: The bedroom battle: charms, mirror-substitutes, the Spirit Medium Mirror's climbing woman, black flames and frost spears — until Kenley vomits his own burning organs
scenes.text_anchor: The silver charm suddenly turned ice-cold

scenes.setting: The battle's end: tarot cards pin the demoness, the Spirit Medium Mirror shows Sharon her own rotting face, and three bullets finish her — but Kenley is gone. 'Perhaps the next one to die would be me'
scenes.text_anchor: The beating heart, the yellowish-green liquid

scenes.setting: Mediumship over Sharon's corpse (visions only: Sharon handing Trissy a bronze book; a white-robed lady preaching 'advance towards the Primordial'): the Demoness Sect's shape emerges
scenes.text_anchor: Klein didn't tarry. He took out the various ingredients

scenes.setting: The mediumship continues (visions only: Sharon brokering Tingen's elite, the white-robed woman, the Pleasure/Witch/Instigator/Assassin formulas): her motive for killing Maynard stays inexplicable
scenes.text_anchor: Synonym of war... A similar Sequence as the Demoness Sequence pathway

scenes.setting: Cleanup orders — then, through the cracked mirror, Klein sees Dunn kneeling over Kenley's body, gray eyes deep, lips tainted with crimson blood
scenes.text_anchor: Klein stopped the ritual and returned to reality.
